summary: Container section for holding banners with responsive column layouts.
features: Full width or boxed layout options
Customizable background color with theme presets
shortDescription: The Container section serves as a flexible wrapper for organizing banners and content blocks into responsive grid layouts. It allows independent column configuration for mobile and desktop breakpoints, enabling designs like single-column mobile with multi-column desktop. Background colors support theme presets or custom values for visual separation. Alignment controls position content within the container. Use this section when you need precise control over how multiple banners or blocks arrange across screen sizes.
